prompts.text: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Hub /projects folder is mounted The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:env-axhub-projects-dir` (service data, status warn) - What it says: AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR isn't set - How the fix failed: There's nothing Brett has to do himself here, just start this fix from an axHub-connected session. The warning stays until then. The permanent fix (having `install-console.sh` set this env var and mount the volume, like the `AXF_PUBLIC_URL` fix) is still waiting on Brett's go.…
